subject: [VOTE] AIP-99 Common Data Access Pattern + AI

messages.subject: [VOTE] AIP-99 Common Data Access Pattern + AI
messages.body:
Hi Everyone,

Kaxil and I would like to calling a vote on this AIP
https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=406618285

The previous discussion thread was
https://lists.apache.org/thread/dgpgvoszh52vxxszmg65wmcgxnj9zwby

Based on the discussion, we have parked cyclicness behaviour to the new AIP.

Thank you everyone who commented on the AIP and responded on the discussion
thread.

The vote will run for 5 days and last till next tuesday, the 20th of Jan
2026 23:30 GMT.

Everyone is encouraged to vote, although only PMC members and Committers'
votes are considered binding.

Please vote accordingly

[ ] +1 Approve
[ ] +0 no opinion
[ ] -1 disapprove with the reason

Since Kaxil and I are co-authoring this, please consider this is our +2
binding :)

Regards,
Kaxil and Pavan

messages.subject: Re: [VOTE] AIP-99 Common Data Access Pattern + AI
messages.body:
+1 binding. Good work on the amount of detail and the market research
performed
to identify the gaps Airflow has when it comes to AI workloads and helping
prepare
for the AI era to come.

I would also be in favour of making the provider changes first. Not sure if
this has been
discussed already, but `airflow.providers.ai` sounds a bit odd to me, maybe
something
like `common.ai` or `common.llm` would make more sense to me.


Thanks & Regards,
Amogh Desai

Yeah we had a discussion on the naming [1] , it will be`
apache-airflow-providers-common-ai`   if anyone would like to propose a new
name , happy to discuss further.

@shahar, thanks for offering help, definitely it will be really helpful. :)
I will notify you when things start moving.

Regards,
Pavan
